notes.title: Early Access 1.55 Full Patch Notes
notes.content: [p][b]Attention, Operators.[/b] Early Access 1.55 for [i]Black One Blood Brothers[/i] is upon us, laying the foundation for a more modern version of the game. While you may notice that no new gear or weapons have been added, don’t worry: Helios and the team are currently satisfied with the amount of choices available for customizing your squad. Upon release, you will have access—free as an owner of the game—to the full arsenal and gear options. We won’t spoil too much for now, but rest assured that Helios is extremely busy behind the scenes.[/p][p][/p][p]We ask for patience, as we’ll be able to share more about these… “details” once they are finalized and we feel comfortable revealing them to the community. Expect some exciting answers by the end of the calendar year.[/p][p][/p][p]For EA 1.55, the main focus is on AI and operator/enemy behavior, as well as UI enhancements. We know that AI is one of the most important aspects of a solo tactical FPS. While immersion can mean many things, we believe the devil is in the details: flinching, idle animations, enemies having conversations, random patrols… Helios is introducing these subtle touches that enhance the atmosphere of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]To strike a balance between player control and natural reactions when the unexpected happens, operators—and enemies too—will now be able to take cover dynamically when under fire. They can also sustain fire while moving, reinforcing the strategic importance of suppressive fire.[/p][p][/p][p]Finally, improvements to the menu and tactical map UI will make the shift toward a more modern, efficient design, making navigation smoother and easier for you.[/p][p][/p][h2]FEATURED[/h2][list][*][p]Addition: AI Operators now auto-take cover under fire; behavior is configurable via the new Tac-map toggle,[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: AI enemies flinch on near-misses before taking cover, and can now fire while moving,[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2] GAMEPLAY[/h2][list][*][p]Addition: Tac-map option to choose whether an operator can take cover when under enemy fire,[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: New tab in the campaign hub displaying the mission site’s satellite location,[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: Empty rooms on the “Central Hospital” map are now filled with supplies,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Doors forced open now swing open much faster,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Character highlighting becomes completely invisible when the “Hide UI” option is enabled in Photo Mode,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Enemy and ally counts on the map are always at maximum when “War” or “Siege” mode is enabled,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Interior design of the “Lost Island” map’s buildings,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Default real-time playback speed in Photo Mode is set to minimum,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Automatic leaning could still activate when the player performed a specific action,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Bullet direction error in ADS view with the “Massberg 591 Stockwave”,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Operators could have synchronized animations when simultaneous orders were given on the tac-map,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Explosive object highlight error in Photo Mode,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Selecting a character’s rotation activated real-time mode too often in Photo Mode,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Camera movement did not stop when entering Photo Mode,[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]AI[/h2][list][*][p]Addition: Operators dynamically take cover when a bullet passes nearby,[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: Operators keep moving along their player-assigned path while firing at their target,[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: Enemies can move toward their cover point while firing at their opponents,[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: Unalerted enemies flinch, then enter combat after a brief delay when a bullet whizzes past them or hits the ground nearby,[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: Enemies that have begun to spot you instantly go on alert if a bullet impacts nearby,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Enemies take cover as soon as a bullet passes nearby,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Suppressive fire is now much more effective at forcing enemies to take cover,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Enemy would not fire in the training level when the “RECON” game mode was selected in the mission menu,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Enemy vision bug that lets them fire without properly seeing their target,[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]RENDERING[/h2][list][*][p]Overhaul: Main menu design,[/p][/*][*][p]Overhaul: New options selection UI (mission, difficulty, game settings, etc.),[/p][/*][*][p]Overhaul: Muzzle flash VFX,[/p][/*][*][p]Overhaul: Bullet impact VFX,[/p][/*][*][p]Overhaul: Fragmentation grenade explosion VFX,[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: New graphics option to choose your preferred upscaler (DLSS, FSR, or XeSS),[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: Ambient gunfire in “War” and “Siege” modes,[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: New ambient operator animations in the helicopter during the insertion cinematic,[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: New thumbnails of campaigns,[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: Overall opacity beneath the ocean,[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: Time of day and weather are now randomized during the mission start deployment cinematic,[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: Bullet casings appear on the ground when the “Corpse Visibility” option is enabled,[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: Missing french and german translations,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Ragdoll physics,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Main menu options design,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Difficulty options design,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Redesigned several icons,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Debriefing level[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As usual, thank you for your support and constructive feedback, they mean the world to us! Please let us know your thoughts on the Discord and in the comment sections.[/p][p][/p][p]Kane, Out.[/p]

notes.title: Early Access 1.54 - Full Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Attention, Operators,[/p][p][/p][p]With Early Access 1.54 now available, you will enjoy the following fixes and changes in the game. While this is a shorter patch notes than former updates, some features or improvements are made to experience some behaviors before bigger changes. As usual, please remember that your constructive feedback is valuable.[/p][p][/p][p]Two main features: an overhaul of the dynamic light in game, allowing you - and your enemies - to experience a brand new dynamic in your gameplay. They will hunt you. They will find you. And they might kill you.[/p][p][/p][p]Another big new feature is the start of the maps reworks. We understand that they are at the heart of  the strategic intensity of your games. This is why Helios has reworked 4 maps: expect some tactical changes on Al-Jan Province, University, Valenwood Villa and Klettgau Forest. We also heard some of you who really loved wider maps: you will be able to use them and build your dream mission / campaigns with them.[/p][p][/p][p]And finally, as we want to explore an immersive angle, now, depending on the mission, civilian corpses will be on the map. If that's an option that you don't want to have, you can entirely disable it.[/p][p][/p][p]A lot is going on behind the scenes, as we're making our way to the full release of the game. While we can't reveal our secrets, rest assured: good things are coming.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support. We really hope that you will enjoy this update, and again, Helios is listening on Discord to your feedback and suggestions. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/4d9067ac860530505ce96459e59c0967a1919725.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Read the full patch notes here.[/p][p][/p][p][b]FEATURED[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Overhaul: Dynamic light rendering,[/p][/*][*][p]Overhaul: Number of dynamic lights on maps during night missions,[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: AI enemies can now see your weapon’s laser dot and flashlight beam,[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: Corpse visibility (Shows the aftermath of the enemy strike — civilian corpses and other attack traces (visual only, no gameplay impact),[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: Options for controlling character animations in Photo/Video mode,[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: Custom mouse cursor,[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]GAMEPLAY[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Addition: Option in difficulty tab - Corpse visibility,[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: Option in extras - Sensitive Content,[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: Player-controlled operator now communicates with the team over the radio,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Overall design of the “Al-Jan Province” map,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Overall design of the “University” map,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Overall design of the “Valenwood Villa” map,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Overall design of the “Klettgau Forest” map,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Smoothness of the movement transition when the player aims with a scope,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Accidental disappearance of an unconscious or dead operator on the “University” map,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Accidental disappearance of an unconscious or dead operator on the “Carrier Deck” map,[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fix: Some streetlight bulbs might not have been destroyed properly[/p][/*][/list][p][b]MAP EDITOR[/b][/p][list][*][p]Addition: Empty map (very large),[/p][/*][*][p]Addition: Aircraft Carrier,[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]RENDERING[/b][/p][list][*][p]Addition: New Ranks menu,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Player’s arm animation in first-person view while crawling is now synchronized with their movement,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: 3D icon showing the objective’s location is greyed out if the objective hasn’t been located yet,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Design and size of the radial menu for switching operators,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Design of progression menu in campaign mode,[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement: Design of photo/video UI,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Missing materials on some ceilings on the “Central Hospital” map,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Undesirable artifact effect inside magnifying scopes,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Motion blur could be activated in the campaign hub or during debriefing,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Hollow inside a magnifying scope could display visual glitches,[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Left hand wasn’t correctly positioned when throwing a grenade if the player was using side aiming in first-person view[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: EASTERN FORCES UPDATE
notes.content:
Greetings, Operators.

It’s time to dive deep into what’s waiting for you in Black One Blood Brothers Early Access Update 1.53. This update isn’t just cosmetic—it brings powerful improvements to gameplay and immersion, many of which come directly from your feedback. So keep it coming.

[previewyoutube=g_LtBQoLyCg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Tactical Depth, Reinforced[/h1]

You asked—Helios delivered.

You can now synchronize shots on multiple targets in real-time. Simply mark your enemies, and they’ll be automatically assigned to the nearest Operator with a clear line of sight. All that’s left is to give the signal

This system allows for faster, more fluid decision-making without opening the TacMap, enhancing your squad’s tactical efficiency and your immersion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/c91b41f029c0de9f0d4833d80a7bcf0cff63923d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Combat Improvements Across the Board[/h1]

The Aim Down Sight (ADS) system has been reworked for a smoother, more responsive experience.

Visual issues with certain sights? Fixed.

The recoil system has been overhauled for more realistic handling.

And thanks to a new automatic leaning system, your Operator now adapts dynamically to cover—no extra input needed. Peek smarter, move smoother.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/5fcee58f1673aa969fd1067d3acaa93a2dd32982.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Cosmetics & Gear[/h1]

Dress your squad for the mission:

New weapons, camos, accessories, and equipment inspired by Eastern European military forces are now available.

These additions add new depth to your squad customization, giving you even more ways to make your Operators your own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/cf24cea13eaa53eb39d7e8cec26fb68eab35b0e9.jpg[/img]

[h1]German Language Support[/h1]

For the very first time, the game is fully available in German. This marks the beginning of Helios’s global localization plan, with more languages to be added in version 1.0 at the end of Early Access.

The full patch notes are available below.

As always, your feedback is mission-critical—drop your thoughts in the comments.
Stay sharp.
 —Kane, out.

notes.title: Preview Gameplay 1.53 - Eastern Forces
notes.content:
Attention, Operators—

The new major Early Access update for Black One Blood Brothers, titled "Eastern Forces", will arrive in mid-April! But before its deployment, here’s a quick briefing on what to expect. This update isn’t just about new uniforms for your squad — it’s a real step forward in the game's development. Here’s what you need to know about this major update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/cf24cea13eaa53eb39d7e8cec26fb68eab35b0e9.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Feature: Synchronized Shots
[/h1]
You asked for it—Helios delivered. Tactics on the field just got sharper. In addition to quick orders, you can now synchronize your squad’s shots. Mark a target and it’ll be assigned to the nearest Operator. Count to three… and let them fly.

Just make sure your line of sight is clear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/5fcee58f1673aa969fd1067d3acaa93a2dd32982.jpg[/img]

[h1]Overhaul: Aim Down Sight (ADS) System
[/h1]
Immersion has always been at the heart of Helios’ vision. That’s why aiming has been completely reworked. No more jarring camera movements—the transition into your sights is now smooth and natural, giving you tighter control when it matters most.

[h1]Overhaul: Shooting Animations & Recoil
[/h1]
To take realism to the next level, the recoil system has been rebuilt from the ground up. Instead of static or unnatural reactions, Operators now use dynamic data to generate procedural recoil patterns with every shot. Reloads and weapon handling have also been updated with smoother, more lifelike animations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/26e0f8b2b0b60fb551ae9cfb53bca0634bad76cc.jpg[/img]

[h1]Overhaul: Leaning System[/h1]

Tactical movement matters. In FPS view, your operator will now lean automatically when close to walls or corners. You’ll control the lean direction with your mouse to peek around angles while staying in cover and maintaining stealth.

These are just a few of the features coming your way—and we can’t wait for you to try them. As always, your feedback is crucial. Join us on Discord or Steam to share your thoughts and help shape what’s next.

Black One Blood Brothers: Eastern Forces launches mid-April on Steam. Make sure to follow us to stay up to date—an in-depth patch notes article will drop on release day with everything you need to know.
Until then… stay sharp, Operators.

notes.title: Black One Blood Brothers - "Eastern Forces" preview
notes.content:
Stand by, Operators.

Black One Blood Brothers Early Access 1.53 – [b]"Eastern Forces" is inbound, bringing a fresh arsenal, enhanced tactics, and long-requested features to the battlefield.[/b] Here’s your intel briefing on what’s coming next.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/3509db19725a1cd5f72e0467479d2868ae3410aa.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW GEAR, NEW LOADOUTS, NEW WEAPONS[/h1]

Gear up with authentic Eastern European military equipment, including Ballistic Shields, Helmets, Plate Carriers, and a wider range of civilian attire suited for urban warfare. Whether your mission calls for discretion or heavy engagement, these additions expand your tactical options.

Your arsenal is also growing with weapons used by forces across Eastern Europe, each arriving with its respective attachments. [b]Precision, firepower, and reliability—ready for deployment.[/b]

[h1]SYNCHRONIZED SHOT – COORDINATED PRECISION[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/7adc9131b888ae81808af010d671b833bb771599.jpg[/img]

Your requests have been heard—synchronized shots are now part of Black One Blood Brothers. Line up your targets, set your sights, and execute simultaneous eliminations with precision. [b]A dedicated tutorial will ensure you master this new tactical tool[/b], and to top it off, new voicelines will accompany every well-executed takedown. Stay sharp.

[h1]ADDITIONAL IMPROVEMENTS & FIXES[/h1]

Beyond the headline features, expect AI enhancements, [b]sound effects for guns with suppressors improved[/b], campaign adjustments, and overall system optimizations. The full patch notes will be deployed at launch.

Black One Blood Brothers "Eastern Forces" is deploying in April on Steam. Get ready. Stay lethal.

Kane, out

notes.title: Mise à jour "Western Forces" disponible dès maintenant !
notes.content:
[b]Attention, Operators.[/b] Black One Blood Brothers Early Access Update **"Western Forces"** is now live. Let’s deep dive into what you can expect from this update:

[h1]New Equipment based on the Western Special Forces[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/b16db741ce0cf6a08b52a435e1d2692933d52445.gif[/img]

Time to head to the squad editor: the Western Forces are here! This update brings a wide array of new equipment, weapons, and gear inspired by Western nations. From new backpacks, gloves, and tactical pouches to grips, suppressors, barrels, and base weapons, you now have the tools to shape your squad exactly how you envision it. Will you opt for a fully realistic approach, or craft a unique mix-and-match setup using your favorite components? The choice is yours! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/36fcca88ba72491e6cf62c4bfbde720a1b08c90f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Introducing AI Improvements[/h1]

Your feedback has always been our priority, and improving AI is at the core of this update. Enemy NPCs now feature new resting stances when idle, adding a touch of realism to their behavior. Alongside their existing animations, discussions, and poses, they can now patrol with flashlights, scouring every corner for signs of your operators at night. No stone will be left unturned. Pay close attention to their actions: enemies will now take cover more intelligently, adapting to their environment in smarter ways. Additionally, squad improvements have been made to enhance teamwork. Squadmates now exhibit a better, faster, and smarter understanding of complex environments, allowing them to follow their leader more efficiently. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/de33ab99dac20711225bad2532dcbca9a785b8aa.jpg[/img]

[h1]General Improvements[/h1]

Helios has listened to your feedback, and several changes have been implemented to refine your experience. 

- [b]Improved Loading Experience[/b] – We know the first load after an update can be confusing. Starting now, game loading will include animations to help distinguish between normal behavior and potential issues. 
- [b]Operator Presets[/b] – Jump into action faster with the addition of operator presets, which let you fine-tune personnel selection alongside squad presets. 
- [b]Map Optimization[/b] – Enila Island and Al-Jan Province have been resized for a smoother experience, while Burnwood Mansion and Jin-Shu Temple exteriors have received upgrades. 
- [b]UI Updates[/b] – The interface has been tweaked, with noticeable changes in menus and pre-mission designs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/67fbeb853123564d9796a79af376b7247be9c9e8.jpg[/img]

[h1]Photo Mode[/h1]

Capture the moments that matter. With the new photo mode, you can pose your squad before deployment, whether for a keepsake or to commemorate their camaraderie. Customize their stances to make each photo unique—whether it’s a smile before the mission or a tribute to a fallen brother. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/7a0c747cab6b1cced0d7bd7f341e044c676129b3.jpg[/img]

And that’s just the beginning. Dive in now to explore the full range of fixes, improvements, and features included in this update. Stay sharp, Operators. And Read the full release notes here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/57674c64ac267a35a76875ca149e2f60fad47925.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Preview - Early Access Update 1.52 "Western Forces"
notes.content:
Greetings, Operators,

The wait is almost over. Helios is thrilled to announce that the Early Access 1.52 "Western Forces" update is set for release on February, 3rd, 18:00 GMT +1. To make the wait easier, here’s a sneak peek at some of the most anticipated features coming to Black One Blood Brothers. As always, we’d love to hear your feedback, and we truly hope you’ll enjoy this update!

[h1]New Year, New Gear: Weapons, Attachments, and More[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/fedd611a10ea4ae718a7c44474a563a28ee53217.jpg[/img]

For the first time, this update has a name—Western Forces. Moving forward, certain aspects of each update—especially gear, weapons, and equipment—will be inspired by real-world forces. You’ll be able to create your dream squad, customizing uniforms to build a deeper backstory around your team. Of course, for legal reasons, these forces won’t be explicitly named—but you’ll recognize the essence.

[h1]Enhancing Immersion
[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/4672bbad0a6c6c7843c595702e40dee1b3be59c1.jpg[/img]

We’ve been listening to your feedback, and we know how crucial immersion is to your experience. Good news:

[b]Revamped Enemy Factions [/b]– Enemies now have distinct uniforms and unique appearances, allowing you to recognize them at a glance. This provides better battlefield clarity—and helps avoid any... unfortunate friendly fire incidents.
[b]New Weapon Resting Stances[/b] – AI operators now have two additional idle stances, making their weapon handling feel more natural.
[b]Enhanced Night Missions – [/b]Enemy NPCs will now patrol with flashlights, actively searching for intruders.

And that’s not all—the Devil is in the details, so keep an eye on how enemy AI takes cover.

[h1]Quality of Life Improvements
[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/2e87e725ffcf1c3027bb266a66bae3e9c467f4f0.jpg[/img]

What’s an update without QoL enhancements? Thanks to your feedback, Helios has introduced fixes and new systems to refine your gameplay experience.

[b]Optimized Game Loading[/b] – We know that shader compilation after a major update can take time, and that the first load into the home screen can be anxiety-inducing—Is it frozen? Is it still loading? With the brand-new loading system, you’ll instantly know whether you need to worry or just be patient.
[b]New Operator Presets[/b] – Customize and switch between operator presets quickly, making squad assembly smoother and getting you into action faster.
[b]On going changes in the AI [/b]and diverse improvements.
[h1]
Photo mode[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/cb2f40fc8b95a5069c5bb729a008facef6d1cb29.jpg[/img]

Whether you feel like you’re part of a family, or brothers in arms, or a fearless squad, don’t forget to take a picture before going in. We’re excited to introduce a new part to the photo mode, in which you can control the poses of your operators. For some, it’s just a smile to the camera, for others, it’s their very last memories with a brother. Let’s get creative.

There’s still much more to reveal, so stay tuned for the official patch notes. Until then, stay sharp and stay safe, Operators.

notes.title: Happy New Year - Here's what's next for Black One Blood Brothers
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First of all, I wish you all a very Happy New Year! I hope 2025 brings you health, happiness, and success!

I want to thank you for your unwavering support for Black One Blood Brothers. Whether through your feedback, encouragement, or simply by being here, it means the world to me. Developing a game solo is a constant challenge, but you help me move forward every day. Thank you!

Today, I’m sharing my “roadmap” for the game, highlighting the different aspects I’ll be working on to continue enriching and improving Black One Blood Brothers in 2025.

[h1]Mocap Suit Acquisition[/h1]

A significant technical milestone on my end: I’ve acquired a Mocap Suit! This tool will allow me to create much more realistic and varied animations. It will take some time, but the goal is to greatly enhance immersion for operators, enemies, and cinematics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/90d41c04ad657f6d6024a427acdf1d446c026c0c.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Content[/h1]

New weapons, accessories, outfits, and equipment—exciting content is coming this year!

[b]Western Forces:[/b] Inspired by Western special forces, featuring a variety of weapons and equipment.
[b]Eastern Forces:[/b] Bringing an Eastern flair, with unique styles and gear.

These additions will provide even more customization options for your squads.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/7246b37224cf32ce3bb9d05fa8ec7cca5b323f3c.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Operator Customization[/h1]

I’m also working on improved operator customization. Soon, you’ll be able to modify their body shapes and adjust their facial features. I hope this new feature helps you make your squad even more unique.

[h1]New Maps: Psychiatric Asylum and Mountain Region[/h1]

Two new maps are in the works:
[b]Psychiatric Asylum:[/b] A tense, tactical map designed to feel oppressive.
[b]Ancient Temple:[/b] A more open area featuring buildings and strategic points.

[h1]Gameplay Improvements[/h1]

This year’s focus will be on refining gameplay!

AI with more precise and adaptive behaviors.
Revised sounds to enhance atmosphere.
A more intuitive user interface for smoother navigation.
And, of course, bug fixes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/03ba001c92998471cb461ea3dab64484f5affedc.jpg[/img]

[h1]Enhanced Immersion[/h1]

I’m continuing to work on immersion and narrative elements in the game. This includes more polished cinematics, refined animations, and new voiceovers. These are small steps, but I hope they make a big difference for you.

[h1]Update 1.52[/h1]

Before all these updates, here’s what’s coming in the next 1.52 update:

A photo mode to capture your operators in their best moments.
New weapons and accessories.
Even more outfits and equipment.
Resting weapon postures to diversify animations.
Enemies using flashlights during nighttime missions.
New weather options for greater variety.
An improved enemy cover selection system.
Stronger faction identities with more diverse outfits.
Thank you again for supporting the game with such enthusiasm. Feel free to share your feedback or ideas. Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/c2YRHZjwvz]the Discord server[/url]! Your input helps the game evolve.

See you soon,
HELIOS

notes.title: Early Access 1.51 - New Maps, new gears, new UAV
notes.content:
Greetings Operators. 

The time is now! Discover the complete patchnotes for Early Access 1.51. 

As usual, let us know your feedback on Discord! 

Here are the main features to look at:

[h1]New Maps[/h1]

Two new maps are ready for deployment, offering unique tactical challenges. The Carrier Deck is a tight, linear battlefield, perfect for intense close-quarters combat. Its straightforward design keeps the action fast and focused, with little room for error. In contrast, the Stronghold opens up vast strategic possibilities, with a diverse layout featuring ample cover, ambush points, and sniper-friendly zones. It’s an ideal playground for sharpshooters and spotters to outmaneuver the enemy. Both maps demand precision, adaptability, and tactical finesse.

[h1]The Campaign Editor[/h1]

This is your chance to take full command. With the Campaign Editor, you’re no longer just a player—you’re the architect of war. Design every detail of your operation, from the maps to the narratives, crafting missions that expand the lore of Black One Blood Brothers. Once your masterpiece is complete, share it with the community on Steam Workshop and inspire others to join the fight. Your creativity is the key to building a richer, deeper world. Let’s see what you’ve got!

[h1]UAV device has never seen before[/h1]

Air support just got a massive upgrade. The outdated radio kit has been retired and replaced by the advanced UAV Kit, giving you four powerful options for air superiority. Use it to scout the terrain, call in precise artillery strikes, or identify the perfect landing zone for supply drops. Take direct control of the drone, and turn the tides of battle with cutting-edge tactical capabilities. The sky is no longer the limit—it’s your advantage.

[h1]A more lively world[/h1]

The world of Black One Blood Brothers is evolving. Enemies now exhibit more dynamic behaviors, interacting with each other during idle moments to create a more immersive battlefield. Hostages have also been overhauled with greater diversity and more realistic responses to threats, raising the stakes of every rescue mission. Additionally, the mall has been enriched with new furniture and cover options, adding layers of strategy to firefights.

Helios is committed to continually refining the AI and world design. These changes are just the beginning, with more enhancements already in the pipeline.

[h1]And much, much more[/h1]

Version EA 1.51 is packed with new features and improvements. Personalize your squad with new weapons, gear, and roles to suit your playstyle. The map editor now includes additional props and buildings, giving you even more tools to craft your dream scenarios. From quality-of-life upgrades to expanded creative possibilities, this update ensures there’s always something new to discover.

This isn’t just an update—it’s an evolution. Your feedback and creativity fuel the future of Black One Blood Brothers. We can’t wait to see the missions and campaigns you create, and we’re excited to continue this journey with you.

Happy gaming, operators. Let’s connect on Steam, Discord, or Reddit—the battlefield awaits!

[h1]FEATURED[/h1]
- Addition: Custom Campaigns + Steam Workshop
- Addition: UAV Device
- Addition: New map - New World Stronghold
- Addition: New map - Carrier Deck

notes.title: Preview EA 1.51 - Features
notes.content:
Greetings, Operators

The wait is over. Early Access 1.51 is on its way, and with each update, we’re committed to making Black One Blood Brothers even better. Helios has been hard at work, bringing you fresh content and features to elevate your tactical experience. Let’s dive into the most anticipated changes and surprises he has prepared for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/51e19550cee147f8dee90b91c32c098ba71fc8b6.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Maps[/h1]

Prepare for two new battlegrounds: New World Stronghold and Carrier Desk. Each map brings unique challenges that will test your strategy and adaptability.

On Carrier Desk, you’ll need to get creative. The map’s tight corridors and open spaces, along with aircrafts, helicopters, crates, and boxes, offer limited cover. Once you’re in a corridor, it’s you or them—so stay sharp and choose your path carefully.

The Stronghold map offers more deployment options but raises the stakes. Enemies will exploit natural cover and high ground, so adjust your tactics to maintain the upper hand.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/5f111c599158a73074756313fe18b468f65a84b7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/1b40980f21f26f7f64a6c39103b5e16f5b9967b8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/4e80fda385291240af80339e8eb9551f075081b7.jpg[/img]


[h1]UAV Device[/h1]

Introducing a new level of air support: the UAV reworked, arriving in EA 1.51. This powerful tool unlocks four tactical options for you and your squad:

[b]Recon:[/b] Fly over enemy positions, locate hostages or VIPs, and secure vital intel.
[b]Ping a Landing Zone: [/b]Need supplies? Mark the optimal landing zone and retrieve your gear fast.
[b]Missile Strike (Small Area):[/b] Execute up to 30 precision strikes with a limited blast radius.
[b]Missile Strike (Large Area):[/b] For maximum impact, launch one of four large-scale strikes. Use them wisely.

Just make sure one of your operators is carrying an UAV kit to call for air support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/215f1fe23dad0b105083c4b9c2cb6ed5936f7860.jpg[/img]

[h1]Custom Campaign Feature[/h1]

Here’s your chance to design the perfect military campaign. With the Custom Campaign Editor, you can customize every detail—from mission names and briefings to officers in command and intel—crafting your own legend within the Black One Blood Brothers universe.

Take it further by creating custom maps to integrate into your campaigns, then share them on the Steam Workshop. It’s your time to shine, Operator—unleash your creativity and write your legacy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/7e9d160b1dca46f9da252ee46d357b3942a7347e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Community-Driven Enhancements[/h1]

Helios is always listening to feedback that makes a meaningful impact on the game’s realism and the community’s experience. Based on valuable insights from you, this update will include:

[b]New Ambient Animations for NPCs: [/b]Enemies now display contextual animations while idling, creating a more immersive and lifelike environment. More diversity in the hostages would be noticed as well.
[b]Role Assignment for Operators: [/b]Assign roles to optimize your squad’s effectiveness and streamline battlefield management.
[b]Quality of Life Improvements: [/b]Numerous enhancements to make your experience smoother and more engaging.
And there’s even more: cosmetics, new gear, weapons, attachments, and various fixes are all included in this update to keep the experience fresh and realistic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/19e7f2bf4c97e8f535b554a8fbd3bb8e86caa390.jpg[/img]

As always, the full patch notes will be available at launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/0cc2b7b898c3f592a5087516c33f2a98627e6a83.jpg[/img]

[h1]Mark Your Calendars[/h1]

Black One Blood Brothers EA 1.51 drops on [b]November 18, 2024[/b], alongside a brand new video. We’re excited for you to experience the latest improvements, and we encourage you to keep sharing your thoughts on Discord. Your relevant feedback plays a crucial role in shaping the game into an experience that feels authentic and engaging.

Thank you for your continued support. It means the world to us.

Kane, out.

notes.title: Black One Blood Brothers Early Access 1.50 - Patch notes
notes.content:
Dear Operators,

The moment is here. Black One Blood Brothers Early Access 1.50 is almost live, and we’re eager to hear your thoughts and see you in action! Helios has worked tirelessly to integrate the most requested features and fixes from the Beta Test. A special thanks to our playtesters, and extended gratitude to all active players for their constructive feedback—it’s helping us make the game even better.

Now, it's time to dive into the full patch notes of this brand-new update. Please remember that Black One Blood Brothers is still in Early Access, and we are committed to delivering a better experience with each major update.

[h1]Main Features[/h1]

The reworked inventory and gunsmith systems are set to be game-changers: choose your gear and attachments wisely, as they’ll have a real impact on the battlefield. With a diverse range of base weapons, accessories, optics, and attachments, you can create a truly unique arsenal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/06cea176476b80bc4a3daee10105ec10d56be6f7.gif[/img]

Operators have been completely revamped for more immersive and realistic animations. The patch system has also received a significant overhaul.

Precision scopes have been improved for a smoother experience, and a new camo system lets you customize your weapons to your liking.

The character system has been updated with new color options and tattoos visible on forearms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/9561dfbbc13b0d94c5dfc91a83971871a2947025.jpg[/img]

The long-awaited pre-made squads system is finally here! If you're looking to jump into a mission quickly without configuring your squad, just select from a variety of pre-made options.

The UI has been completely reworked, from the TacMap to squad management and quick orders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/746edfa30e791c143d3e25efcd13c9a5676a9c39.jpg[/img]

The AI has seen continuous improvements on both your squad’s side and enemy behavior. Expect more realistic actions and better prioritization, but note this is just a step in ongoing AI enhancements.

Smaller details like improved visibility of extraction zones through smoke and the ability to check ammo in your mags have also been addressed.

And the cherry on top: a full revamp of the game's key art, logo, and a brand-new trailer premiering at 6 PM CEST on YouTube!

[previewyoutube=ol1zbHQ_wUQ;full][/previewyoutube]

As always, please report any issues or bugs on our Discord, and we’ll work on getting them fixed ASAP.

Happy gaming, Kane, out.

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS 1.50 PREVIEW - RELEASE ON SEPTEMBER 23, 6PM CEST
notes.content:
Greetings, Operators!

After an incredible playtest with over 100 participants, Helios has been hard at work, taking your feedback to heart. We've decided to postpone the Early Access release, but for all the right reasons—to make Black One Blood Brothers Early Access 1.50 the best it can be! We’re beyond grateful for your insights and can’t wait to show you the changes we’ve made. We're on the verge of a defining moment for the game.

So, let’s dive into some of the highly anticipated features coming your way in Black One Blood Brothers Early Access 1.50!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/51d8ec852da4a78aaf40043bdb266c007baed298.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Inventory, Operators, and Weapons—Your Way[/h1]

The Gunsmith system has received a complete overhaul. No more cookie-cutter weapons—now it’s all about your creativity! Build your weapon from the ground up, from base parts to optics and accessories. With more customization options than ever before, your gun will be as unique as your playstyle.

Operators have also been upgraded, offering better animations and customization options. Want a unified squad look? You can now easily apply changes across your entire team with quick shortcuts and save those settings for future missions. Make sure your squad looks as good as they fight!

Speaking of equipment, the inventory system has been revamped for a more streamlined experience. We’ve made adjustments to the weight system based on your feedback, making it more realistic. Your gear now matters—each piece contributes to your camouflage, armor, and overall effectiveness in battle, so choose wisely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/baa8e92572e3794109b5fb170cef90f3f197dbf3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/06cea176476b80bc4a3daee10105ec10d56be6f7.gif[/img]

[h1]Be the Ultimate Tactical Mastermind[/h1]

The Tactical Map and Quick Orders UI have been redesigned. It’s never been easier to distribute commands to your team, ensuring smooth and quick execution—after all, time is everything on the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/a6e2b6595c03462cd09c5c30b5023b34ac98cc2b.jpg[/img]

The TacMap is essential to Black One Blood Brothers, and we’re committed to making it as intuitive and powerful as possible. You’ll notice these quality-of-life improvements immediately, and we’ll continue to refine them based on your feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/b715349ed7bc6b12a8749eaa65d5778da1b52610.jpg[/img]

[h1]And So Much More...[/h1]

From a brand-new tattoo system to enhanced magnifying scopes and night vision, the improvements don’t stop there. We’ve also made significant AI updates to keep your missions challenging and engaging. A full list of changes will be available in the patch notes on release day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/f29f5e4aa09ce491e000cd047e5b0cb2019c3034.jpg[/img]

There is also a full revamp of some key visuals of the game and... a brand new trailer coming in hot?

Mark your calendars—Black One Blood Brothers Early Access 1.50 launches on September 23rd at 6pm CEST (Paris time). We’re counting down the days and can’t wait to hear your thoughts once you get your hands on all the new content!

And remember, bugs and issues may still arise, so don’t hesitate to join our Discord to report any problems and share your experiences with the community.

Until then, stay sharp.

Kane, out.

Calling all Operators, 

As previously teased and discussed during our first community stream, and paving the way for the highly anticipated update 1.50 that will be released in September, we have a freshly out of the press update for you: introducing Black One Blood Brothers 1.49C. 

[h1]Main features[/h1]

[h2]Operator Height[/h2]

Now, you'll be able to custom your operator's height. Your enemies' height will be randomized at spawn as well. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/80fd61efd4c04dabbe3116b9927a844e2be8c8ed.gif[/img]

[h2]Hardcore Mode in campaign
[/h2]
Are you ready to face new extreme challenges? Get ready for a mode that will push you to go big or go home. Failing critical objectives or losing all of your operators will lead you to lose the entire campaign, and you'll have to start over again.

You'll be able to completely customize your campaign. And bare with us, you'll soon learn more about the different options you have to create your own campaign.

[h2]Quick Orders and TacMap revamped[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/9eb66eed7142ad8c4e2d54b5fe6eecbfa221cabb.gif[/img]

We heard you! To make the battle map and quick orders easier to use, Helios has made an entire rework of these elements: more accessible, more intuitive, it has never been that simple to use them. For the quick orders panel, the camera is now the cursor to set up the waypoints/points of interest you would like to set, to minimize the impact of the strategic quick orders on your gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/a721e8873b06ef56b77a650c19489f82a06ebe18.gif[/img]

We really hope that you will enjoy these intermediate patch notes and rendez-vous early September for a ground breaking update. As usual, you are more than welcome to give us feedback on Discord and social media!

See the complete patch notes here:

[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.49: New Maps, Steam Achievements, Photo & Video mode, QOL Improvements
notes.content:
Greetings operators,

It is time. Set to be released on April 3, at 6pm, GMT+1, let’s deep dive in a quick preview of what Black One Blood Brothers 1.49 update has in store for you.

[previewyoutube=krsS_WNBeFE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Mall of Eden & The Mines[/h3]

First and foremost, the highly anticipated two new maps: Mall of Eden and the Mines. Both of them will unlock new endless possibilities of gameplay to enjoy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/3ed61f2cf360d6685de90c0990330b260a557003.jpg[/img]

First, the Mall of Eden is a maze of corridors, shops and rooms, that will allow exciting close combat fights. But beware operators. There is little to no place for mistakes, especially if you have to free hostages or captured agents. Mind the cameras, be stealthy, and plan carefully your next moves.

If you’re more into open theatres, you will enjoy the Mines. With a strong verticality and natural covers, you’ll have to be smarter than your enemies to take advantage of the topography of the map. It’s easy to lose yourself on the bridge and get caught off by the beauty of nature, but you’ll be completely vulnerable on this part of the map. So hurry up, keep your feet off the edges, and focus on your objectives.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/fd50714c6578fe674a14a02b58e7f7a7a0c7e5db.jpg[/img]

[h3]Photo & Video Mode[/h3]

1.49 is also bringing a fan favorite feature: the photo and video mode. Create great memories of your missions and custom maps, be creative, and take your game to the next level. Whether you’re a content creator or just a cinematographic lover, the photo and video feature will unlock a new horizon to the game. It’s easy to customize every aspect of the picture quality to create the perfect video or photo. Don’t forget to share them with us.

[h3]And much more...[/h3]

Speaking of creativity, tons of new assets are brought to the map editor, from new doors to new environment items. It has never been a better time to bring life to your ideas.

These are not the only new features that you’ll enjoy in the 1.49 update: for instance, a new system of waves is being introduced in the siege and war modes. You’ll also notice some UI and quality of life improvements, such as better menus and way to hold your weapons more realistically, and a brand new soundtrack, for a darker game.

See below for the complete patchnote. We cannot wait for you to try the new update.

notes.title: Preview 1.49: New Maps, Video Mode, Gameplay Enhancements
notes.content:
Dear operatives,

We are thrilled to present the upcoming update for Black One Blood Brothers, featuring two unique new maps and numerous gameplay and interface enhancements.

[h3]Mall of Eden[/h3]

In this mission, your special forces team will face a unique challenge: liberating a giant shopping center seized by determined terrorists. You'll navigate through labyrinthine floors, minimizing civilian casualties while neutralizing the threat

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/09e5b2ab81165488d107b3941bf2d72a2ad9af67.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Mines[/h3]

Dive into the heart of a dense forest where the remnants of an old mine hide the headquarters of an enemy group. Among abandoned buildings and dilapidated structures, your team must navigate cautiously to capture or eliminate enemy leaders. Natural covers offer unique tactical opportunities but also pose high risks of ambushes.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/0f9f1166f6fe2dc52e9621e4e38179d7f68bde25.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Video Mode[/h3]

This groundbreaking update introduces a brand-new video mode, giving players the ability to switch to free camera mode and record unique gameplay sequences. With a specially designed cinema camera, players can capture epic moments of their gaming experience from the perspectives and angles they choose. Whether it's creating impressive videos to share with the community or reliving their most memorable moments, this new video mode adds a new dimension to the Black One Blood Brothers experience. 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/4c21e95e8af6ddcf96ffc492704ec1a66299f8e3.jpg[/img]

[h3]Gameplay Enhancements[/h3]

This update brings a plethora of gameplay and interface enhancements for a more immersive and engaging experience. Weapon handling animations have been reworked for a realistic and fluid feel. The artificial intelligence has been enhanced to offer more responsive and strategic opponents. Game menus have also been optimized. Many other improvements, such as balance adjustments, bug fixes, and performance optimizations, are included to ensure a top-tier gaming experience for all players.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/99f1547fd0781df506994eb124925a3b77f8d509.jpg[/img]

Get ready!
Helios

notes.title: Update 1.48: Dynamic campaign, Blind Ops, New Objectives, DLSS 3.5...
notes.content:
Dear operators,

We are thrilled to announce that update 1.48 for "Black One Blood Brothers" is now available! This release introduces a plethora of new content and exciting improvements to enrich your gaming experience.

[h3]Dynamic Campaign[/h3]

The big news is our dynamic campaign, which transforms each game into a unique adventure. You'll discover never-before-seen locations, varied objectives, and mission conditions that change randomly with each session. You can choose the length of the campaign, but be warned: the difficulty level increases as you progress. The objectives become more and more complex, ensuring a renewed experience with every game.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/24b5f084b92a4de353f14aca83cbec1cdf904573.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Game Mode: "Blind Ops"[/h3]

Dive into the unknown with "Blind Ops," our most unpredictable game mode yet. Embark on missions without any prior knowledge of the location, objectives, weather conditions, or mission specifics. This is the ultimate test of your tactical skills and adaptability to the unexpected. Are you ready to face this new challenge?

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/802e10c5af4890f0884a66eb95f52d51ae840898.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Objectives[/h3]

The update also enriches "Black One Blood Brothers" with new and more complex objectives. These missions require not just brute force but also cunning and strategic preparation. You will need to locate and accomplish these sophisticated objectives, adding a strategic depth to your gameplay.
Visual and Lighting Effects Improvements. We have enhanced the visual effects, especially the lighting effects, to provide a more realistic and immersive experience. Whether it's the sunlight rays or lighting during night missions, everything has been optimized for total immersion, making the game's atmosphere even more captivating.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/47d6748acfc5351b5dc26058aeba3282c82cb29c.jpg[/img]

[h3]DLSS 3.5[/h3]

We are also proud to introduce support for DLSS 3.5 in this update, marking a significant advancement in improving the game's performance and visual quality. With DLSS 3.5, players can enjoy a smoother gameplay experience and enhanced graphics quality, even on less powerful hardware configurations. This AI-driven upscaling technology increases the resolution of images in real-time, allowing you to experience the battles and explorations of "Black One Blood Brothers" with unmatched detail and smoothness.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/5c6419f84f7ba4b598f7be93a4166b179cdb525f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Numerous Gameplay Improvements[/h3]

In addition to these major new features, you will find numerous gameplay improvements designed to make each session smoother, more responsive, and enjoyable. We have listened to your feedback and worked tirelessly to make "Black One Blood Brothers" an even better game.
Update 1.48 is now live, bringing with it a renewed epic adventure. Dive into "Black One Blood Brothers" now to discover all these new features and improvements.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/699d426d82870c23294919fe41c5b1ddb44ffda5.jpg[/img]

Happy gaming to all!
Helios

notes.title: Preview 1.48: Dynamic campaign, Blind ops, new objectives...
notes.content:
Dear Operators,

Attention all "Black One Blood Brothers" players! Update 1.48 is currently in the works and is set to bring unprecedented content and numerous improvements!

[h3]Dynamic Campaign[/h3]

This update introduces a game-changing feature: the dynamic campaign. Experience a unique adventure every time: new locations, varied objectives, and mission conditions generated randomly with each campaign launch. You can choose the number of missions, but beware, the challenge continually increases. The further you progress, the more complex the objectives become. Get ready for a renewed adventure in every game!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/5c1d021d3c517f52bbc3d46fb6fe81b51c9be59d.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Game Mode "Blind Ops"[/h3]

Get ready for the unpredictable game mode: "Blind Ops". In this mode, you will embark on missions without any prior knowledge of the location, objectives, weather conditions, or even mission specifics. It's a true test of your tactical skills and your ability to adapt to the unexpected. Are you prepared to take on the challenge?

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/58639110bfa275d8dc8802ae55fa965355b0e534.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Objectives[/h3]

Update 1.48 enriches "Black One Blood Brothers" with new, more intricate objectives. These missions will require not just brute force, but also intelligence and thorough reconnaissance. You'll need to locate and complete these complex objectives, adding a strategic layer to your gameplay experience.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/19a112c9eed10930aa6c9910e92e72c4554b87c8.jpg[/img]

[h3]Improved Lighting[/h3]

The visual experience of "Black One Blood Brothers" is elevated with enhanced lighting effects. Whether it's natural sunlight or electric lighting during night missions, everything has been reworked for a more realistic and immersive rendering. This visual improvement contributes to an even more captivating and lifelike atmosphere.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/15b5db0db5472b52af0b0a6059a42a1b61a67df7.jpg[/img]

[h3]Numerous Gameplay Improvements[/h3]

In addition to these major new features, Update 1.48 includes numerous gameplay enhancements to enrich your experience. Subtle adjustments have been made to make each game smoother, more responsive, and enjoyable. We've listened to your feedback and worked hard to make "Black One Blood Brothers" an even better game!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/f34f706354f6a4477f12efeea84ed18cbc07ed7c.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned for more information and prepare yourself for an epic adventure with the upcoming Update 1.48 for "Black One Blood Brothers"!

notes.title: Update 1.47: Campaign part 2, Cinematic view, New maps, Bodycam...
notes.content:
Dear Operators,

We are thrilled to introduce the features in the 1.47 update. This update has been designed to enhance your gaming experience by providing fresh elements that we hope will captivate you.

[h3]Campaign - Serpent's Whisper (Part 2)[/h3]

The long-awaited second part of the scripted campaign "Serpent's Whisper" is finally ready to be unveiled, promising to add a new dimension to your adventure.

In this new part, you will be immersed in a world where danger and intrigue weave at every turn. With ten additional missions, each carefully crafted to integrate seamlessly into the overall story, players will have the opportunity to continue their epic journey.

You will face increasingly challenging tasks, each testing your strategic skills and your ability to make quick and effective decisions. The missions of "Serpent's Whisper" are not just about testing your combat skills; they demand tactical thinking, ingenuity, and meticulous planning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/f75ac8e0ac24e873540209df29d2018c0cebbd69.jpg[/img]

[h3]Cinematic View[/h3]

The update will introduce a feature that will radically transform your gaming experience: a new immersive view option for your operator. This innovation is specifically designed for recording gameplay sequences, immersing you in the heart of the action like never before.

Please note, this option is not designed to offer an optimal gaming experience but solely to enrich your recordings and screenshots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/89d52fcb4d33be4ac4ba95dfec65ec1081b74c82.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/d2aed6e481c5083b271dfdef1ffe1d319cc7eee6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/7d8ed22f5b588d4b44d07d3100e203f45cfad33e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/f95dfbe1c6ffebf1caf437d12cc4275320dfa613.jpg[/img]

[h3]Map Additions[/h3]

The world of "Black One Blood Brothers" will expand with the introduction of two distinct maps, designed to challenge your strategy and adaptability.

Secret Bunker: This vast-sized map will transport you to a large-scale military facility. You will face a plethora of defense systems and well-armed patrols. Navigating this environment will require meticulous planning and excellent team coordination to outmaneuver enemy defenses.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/977cdd27745f18ceb307c21e84ca87678068c325.jpg[/img]

The Sanctuary: Picture a hidden sanctuary deep within a dense forest, where every tree can serve as cover, and any sound might betray an enemy's presence. The lush vegetation of this medium-sized map offers unique opportunities for ambushes and stealth maneuvers. Your knowledge of the terrain will be your greatest asset for success.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/c4a0da82ea59d1088a3e4a0a9c49b0b4333cfa97.jpg[/img]

[h3]Bodycam[/h3]

We are excited to announce the introduction of the onboard camera for the operator. With a simple click, this feature will transport you directly into the view of any other operator, offering an immediate perspective on their movements and real-time confrontations. This immersive view will not only allow you to appreciate actions performed by your operators but also to better assess the current situation.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/22340551a498dae6251cf0eb0f2fef519d1006d6.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/a1bda3aefd8e53093564786e3826d39ebfd34e31.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Head Accessories[/h3]

A bush hat and an armored helmet will soon be available, providing even more customization possibilities for your operators!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/a2ee255e015fa66ed8350c2769ce33409d3b5e98.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/8eec4eeb6801f4473eaf1f96ae82db147c1fa653.jpg[/img]

[h3]Gameplay improvements[/h3]

But that's not all! We want to assure you that each update isn't just about adding content but also about the overall enhancement of the game. Thus, this update will also bring numerous improvements to optimize your gameplay experience. We've also taken the time to identify and fix several bugs, thanks to the invaluable feedback from our community. These fixes will contribute to a smoother and more stable game.

Be ready!
Helios

notes.title: Preview 1.47 #2: Campaign part 2, Cinematic view
notes.content:
Dear Operators,

I am excited to introduce the new content that will be added in the upcoming update 1.47.
This update is designed to enrich your gaming experience by introducing unique elements that we hope will captivate you.

[h3]Campaign - Serpent's Whisper (Part 2)[/h3]

The long-awaited second part of the scripted campaign "Serpent's Whisper" is finally ready to be unveiled, promising to add a new dimension to your adventure.

In this new part, you will be immersed in a world where danger and intrigue weave at every turn. With ten additional missions, each carefully crafted to integrate seamlessly into the overall story, players will have the opportunity to continue their epic journey.

You will face increasingly challenging tasks, each testing your strategic skills and your ability to make quick and effective decisions. The missions of "Serpent's Whisper" are not just about testing your combat skills; they demand tactical thinking, ingenuity, and meticulous planning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/f75ac8e0ac24e873540209df29d2018c0cebbd69.jpg[/img]

[h3]Cinematic View[/h3]

The update will introduce a feature that will radically transform your gaming experience: a new immersive view option for your operator. This innovation is specifically designed for recording gameplay sequences, immersing you in the heart of the action like never before.

Please note, this option is not designed to offer an optimal gaming experience but solely to enrich your recordings and screenshots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/89d52fcb4d33be4ac4ba95dfec65ec1081b74c82.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/d2aed6e481c5083b271dfdef1ffe1d319cc7eee6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/f95dfbe1c6ffebf1caf437d12cc4275320dfa613.jpg[/img]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]

In conclusion, the 1.47 update will bring multiple enhancements that will enrich your gaming experience. This update focuses not only on improving the gameplay, making it smoother and more intuitive, but also brings visual enhancements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40417083/ac91178359823951d17102d31389e17b89dc9d89.jpg[/img]

Be ready!
Helios

notes.title: Preview 1.47: New maps, bodycam...
notes.content:
Dear Operators,

We are thrilled to introduce the features coming in the upcoming 1.47 update. This update has been designed to enhance your gaming experience by providing fresh elements that we hope will captivate you.

[h3]Map Additions[/h3]

The world of "Black One Blood Brothers" will expand with the introduction of two distinct maps, designed to challenge your strategy and adaptability.

Secret Bunker: This vast-sized map will transport you to a large-scale military facility. You will face a plethora of defense systems and well-armed patrols. Navigating this environment will require meticulous planning and excellent team coordination to outmaneuver enemy defenses.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/977cdd27745f18ceb307c21e84ca87678068c325.jpg[/img]

The Sanctuary: Picture a hidden sanctuary deep within a dense forest, where every tree can serve as cover, and any sound might betray an enemy's presence. The lush vegetation of this medium-sized map offers unique opportunities for ambushes and stealth maneuvers. Your knowledge of the terrain will be your greatest asset for success.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/c4a0da82ea59d1088a3e4a0a9c49b0b4333cfa97.jpg[/img]

[h3]Bodycam[/h3]

We are excited to announce the introduction of the onboard camera for the operator. With a simple click, this feature will transport you directly into the view of any other operator, offering an immediate perspective on their movements and real-time confrontations. This immersive view will not only allow you to appreciate actions performed by your operators but also to better assess the current situation.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/22340551a498dae6251cf0eb0f2fef519d1006d6.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/a1bda3aefd8e53093564786e3826d39ebfd34e31.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Head Accessories[/h3]

A bush hat and an armored helmet will soon be available, providing even more customization possibilities for your operators!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/a2ee255e015fa66ed8350c2769ce33409d3b5e98.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/8eec4eeb6801f4473eaf1f96ae82db147c1fa653.jpg[/img]

[h3]Gameplay improvements[/h3]

But that's not all! We want to assure you that each update isn't just about adding content but also about the overall enhancement of the game. Thus, this update will also bring numerous improvements to optimize your gameplay experience. We've also taken the time to identify and fix several bugs, thanks to the invaluable feedback from our community. These fixes will contribute to a smoother and more stable game.

Be ready!
Helios

notes.title: Update 1.46: Campaign mode, weather overhaul...
notes.content:
Dear Operators,

I'm thrilled to announce the release of Update 1.46, the culmination of several months of relentless effort. This rollout includes major enhancements that I'm eager to share with you.

[h3]Campaign Mode[/h3]

The long-awaited moment has finally arrived! It's with great pleasure that I introduce the "Campaign" mode. In this saga titled "Serpent's Whisper", you will confront the insurgent group "New World". Having secured substantial financial backing, this group has orchestrated a series of devastating attacks, instilling unprecedented terror on a global scale. Every decision will be pivotal, as the loss of an operator will be permanent throughout the campaign's duration.

The first installment will thrust you right into the heart of the action, while the second will be available in a few months to round off this immersive experience. Once the second part is concluded, you'll have the opportunity to tackle the entire campaign. Remember: the loss of an operator is irreversible.

Various missions and six difficulty levels await. Whether you prefer a smooth progression or seek genuine challenges, there's something for everyone.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/8df3c731e668c41517f83f660e9bc15a7ec4c1c1.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/28e3a8b9e06aa718cff165f23b42b909b83616b0.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/eccea69f6d3002967a5175f77837b6f74eff069e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Weather System Overhaul[/h3]

I'm pleased to announce a comprehensive revamp of the weather and lighting system.

The rendering of the sky and clouds has been thoroughly reworked. Whether it's a dazzling sunset or an overcast sky, each game map now benefits from a photorealistic render.

Moreover, the meteorological system has been entirely reimagined. You can now marvel at the falling rain, lightning streaking across the sky, or snowflakes drifting down. These renewed weather conditions will enhance your in-game immersion.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/6696ed2bdd94ba6c423dea22ffaf7407b1ea0409.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/1d35e9ab9b5e96aa64b0e62e9e44fd9212dcbcd5.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/d0a50e07dda6995480f4b3898d9bca80a1d71eb3.jpg[/img]

[h3]Four-tube Night Vision Goggles Simulation[/h3]

I'm also excited to introduce a significant enhancement for your nighttime operations: the simulation of four-tube night vision goggles. This tool will grant you a wider and more detailed field of view in night mode. I've devoted substantial effort to refining the visual output of this feature and eagerly await your feedback.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/cd99c157738642e49df69781ef9c4ddcb45f3aeb.jpg[/img]

[h3]Gameplay Enhancements[/h3]

Numerous functionalities have been improved and rectified to provide an even more immersive and enjoyable gaming experience, including adjustments to the player's camera, the ability to control a hostage, refined AI, and much more.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/9eb0fea74e0a46e5b91a2fb47d1e89f483e29848.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Customization Options[/h3]

In response to many player requests, I've expanded the customization possibilities. For instance, you can now mix and match various head accessories for each operator, like adding a hood and a helmet to a female character. Simply activate this feature from the main game menu

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/be513e6887b815863318aaeb349aeac457817d4f.jpg[/img]

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]

Future updates will, of course, add Part 2 of the campaign, along with new content.
First off, the ability to craft your own campaigns directly within the game and share them with the community. You can design as many missions as you wish and script your own narratives.

Furthermore, new content will emerge: 3 new maps, new weapons, and much more...

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/e47a084647e2f0c48a3fe7fd62d06ee97a88e0b0.jpg[/img]

I look forward to your feedback on all these novelties.

Best regards,
Helios

notes.title: Preview 1.46: Campaign Game Mode, Weather Overhaul...
notes.content:
Dear operators,

Gear up, our upcoming update 1.46 is just around the corner. I'm thrilled to share with you the new features it brings, including the much-anticipated "Campaign" mode, and much more!

[h3]Campaign Game Mode[/h3]

It's with great pleasure that I announce the main addition of this update for "Black One Blood Brothers": the "Campaign" mode. In this new venture, dubbed "Whisper of the Serpent", you will confront the insurgent group "New World".

This organization, after receiving substantial financial backing, has unleashed a wave of deadly terrorist attacks, instilling unprecedented terror worldwide. In this campaign, each decision is crucial, as the loss of each operator will be permanent until the end of it.

"Whisper of the Serpent" will unfold in two parts, each consisting of 10 intense missions. The first part will immerse you right into the action. A few months later, the second part will complete this gripping adventure. Remember: each operator lost is a loss forever.

A variety of missions and six difficulty levels await you. Whether you prefer a serene progression or tough challenges, every player will find something to their liking.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/eccea69f6d3002967a5175f77837b6f74eff069e.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/8df3c731e668c41517f83f660e9bc15a7ec4c1c1.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/28e3a8b9e06aa718cff165f23b42b909b83616b0.jpg[/img]

[h3]Weather Overhaul[/h3]

I'm also pleased to announce a total overhaul of the weather and lighting system. The improvements made to the visual rendering of the game will amaze you.

On one hand, the rendering of the sky and clouds now reaches a level of photorealistic detail. Whether it's a fiery sunset or an overcast sky, the striking realism of these scenes will astonish you.

On the other hand, I've completely redesigned the weather system. You can now behold the rain falling, lightning streaking through the night, or snowflakes dancing in the air during snowfalls. These renewed weather conditions will enhance your immersion in the game.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/6696ed2bdd94ba6c423dea22ffaf7407b1ea0409.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/1d35e9ab9b5e96aa64b0e62e9e44fd9212dcbcd5.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/d0a50e07dda6995480f4b3898d9bca80a1d71eb3.jpg[/img]

[h3]Four-Tube Night Vision Goggles Simulation[/h3]

Finally, I'm delighted to present a feature that will revolutionize your night operations: the simulation of four-tube night vision goggles. I've worked meticulously on the visual rendering of this feature and can't wait to read your feedback on it!

notes.title: Update 1.45: Operative skills, new game mode, new equipment...
notes.content:
Dear operators,

Update 1.45 is now available. This update once again brings substantial content and numerous improvements.

[h3]Operational Skills:[/h3]
The major addition in this update is the integration of operational skills. There are ten skills in total, allowing you to customize each of your operatives and assign them more specific roles for your missions. These skills will qualify your operatives for combat as well as specific actions such as first aid, reconnaissance, electronics, and much more.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/27aeb12ab6d460bcc31ced3d78e90964635337b9.jpg[/img]

[h3]Game Mode: Recon[/h3]
The new "Recon" game mode is now available. This mode is reserved for all infiltration enthusiasts specializing in reconnaissance and silent movement. During a mission, your objective will be to place multiple listening devices without neutralizing an enemy or being detected. Only the most skilled players will be able to accomplish these missions.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/f8f68ee4850ec113f2bcb02030b9f0a8d4d73873.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Equipment:[/h3]
To increase your chances of success in "Recon" missions, you will have access to new equipment designed specifically for reconnaissance. The "EMP" grenade is capable of destroying all electrical systems, the "Sonar Locator" grenade will mark enemies, the "Decoy Radio" will distract enemies, and the "Electrocution Mine" will silently neutralize any enemy.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/c7ecad2fc40088fbad2e8961a8d370fb38ddca89.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Content, New Gameplay:[/h3]
As always, this update introduces new content and significant gameplay improvements. Of course, numerous fixes have been implemented to address any existing bugs.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/4010aa9854e716bb87d23fe0f7cedff18df54159.jpg[/img]

Cheers,
Helios

notes.title: Preview 1.45: Operative skills, new game mode, new equipment...
notes.content:
Dear Operators,

We are excited to announce that Update 1.45 is currently under development, and it will introduce a much-anticipated feature and a brand new game mode!

[h3]Operational Skills[/h3]

We are extremely proud to unveil the addition of Operational Skills for each of your operators, taking customization to a whole new level. Each skill will allow you to specialize your operators, assigning them specific roles for each mission.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/919eaa9f26895cb1efdf04255508f9785d310be1.jpg[/img]

[h3]Game Mode -> Recon[/h3]

For all the stealth and infiltration professionals, we are introducing a new game mode named "Recon". In this mode, you are tasked with planting several listening devices without neutralizing or being detected by the enemy. This mode will demand patience and keen observation to accomplish your objectives.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/f8f68ee4850ec113f2bcb02030b9f0a8d4d73873.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Equipment[/h3]

To better equip you for "Recon" missions, we are introducing four new high-tech pieces of equipment to enhance your chances of success. The "EMP Grenade" capable of neutralizing all electronic systems, the "Sonar Locator Grenade" for enemy detection, the "Decoy Radio" to distract the enemy, and the "Electrocution Mine" that can silently neutralize any enemy without making a sound.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40417083/c7ecad2fc40088fbad2e8961a8d370fb38ddca89.jpg[/img]

As always, this update will also bring along a host of improvements and bug fixes to enhance your gaming experience. Standby and get ready for an upgraded experience!

Be ready!
Helios

notes.title: Update 1.44: Audio SFX Overhaul, Custom patches...
notes.content:
Dear operators,

The 1.44 update is available and is most likely be one of the biggest updates to the game. The most significant point is the complete overhaul of the sounds for all firearms, as well as 8 different voices for your operators.

[previewyoutube=UQa49qIg1eg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]AUDIO SFX OVERHAUL[/h3]
Each firearm now uses unique and realistic sounds. The sound mixing has been completely rethought to achieve immersive sounds in both semi-automatic and full-automatic modes. The noise of each firearm will be unique depending on the distance from the player.

Additionally, you will be able to choose the voice of your operators from 4 different male and 4 different female voices. By selecting the tone, you can now have unique voices for each of your operators.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/009310d1f7416db61dd331feb644f94b551896c0.jpg[/img]

[h3]CUSTOM PATCHES[/h3]
Many players have requested the ability to add their own fictional or real patches to operators.
This will finally be possible with the arrival of this new update. To allow players to enjoy your creations,
you will be able to share all your patches in the Steam Workshop very easily. Here is an example of patches created by the player "Halacram". Fans of military TV shows will recognize these wonderful patches.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/2f0d9603d380d64f8161f512c521942bc65b97a0.jpg[/img]

Halacram is heavily involved in creating new maps. A big thank you to him for his work, as he is currently working on a series of custom patches that will be available upon the release of the update.

For those who also want to start working on patches right away, here is the link to the guide:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2963625024

[h3]EXPLOSIVE PLACEMENT SYSTEM[/h3]
In addition, a complete revision of explosive placement is under development. This new system
will allow you to place your explosives more efficiently and anywhere in the environment. You will now be able to place an explosive on a door or window to instantly clear a room. If you want to trap your opponent by placing a mine on a wall, you will have the opportunity.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/be525ff55bda69ba8a60cf822f9ff69ff960767f.jpg[/img]

[h3]GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
To conclude, this update will improve and fix numerous elements of the game to make the experience even more immersive!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/4010aa9854e716bb87d23fe0f7cedff18df54159.jpg[/img]

Be ready!
Helios

notes.title: Preview 1.44 #2: Audio SFX Overhaul, Custom patches...
notes.content:
Dear operators,

The 1.44 update is coming soon and will most likely be one of the biggest updates to the game. The most significant point is the complete overhaul of the sounds for all firearms, as well as 8 different voices for your operators.


[h3]AUDIO SFX OVERHAUL[/h3]
Each firearm now uses unique and realistic sounds. The sound mixing has been completely rethought to achieve immersive sounds in both semi-automatic and full-automatic modes. The noise of each firearm will be unique depending on the distance from the player.

Additionally, you will be able to choose the voice of your operators from 4 different male and 4 different female voices. By selecting the tone, you can now have unique voices for each of your operators.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/009310d1f7416db61dd331feb644f94b551896c0.jpg[/img]

[h3]CUSTOM PATCHES[/h3]
Many players have requested the ability to add their own fictional or real patches to operators.
This will finally be possible with the arrival of this new update. To allow players to enjoy your creations,
you will be able to share all your patches in the Steam Workshop very easily. Here is an example of patches created by the player "Halacram". Fans of military TV shows will recognize these wonderful patches.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/2f0d9603d380d64f8161f512c521942bc65b97a0.jpg[/img]

Halacram is heavily involved in creating new maps. A big thank you to him for his work, as he is currently working on a series of custom patches that will be available upon the release of the update.

For those who also want to start working on patches right away, here is the link to the guide:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2963625024

[h3]EXPLOSIVE PLACEMENT SYSTEM[/h3]
In addition, a complete revision of explosive placement is under development. This new system
will allow you to place your explosives more efficiently and anywhere in the environment. You will now be able to place an explosive on a door or window to instantly clear a room. If you want to trap your opponent by placing a mine on a wall, you will have the opportunity.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/be525ff55bda69ba8a60cf822f9ff69ff960767f.jpg[/img]

[h3]GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
To conclude, this update will improve and fix numerous elements of the game to make the experience even more immersive!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/4010aa9854e716bb87d23fe0f7cedff18df54159.jpg[/img]

Be ready!
Helios
