notes.title: Update 1.43: ARIAL Offshore Drilling, Encrypted data...
notes.content:
Dear Operators,

Update 1.43 is now available online, bringing a multitude of content and improvements to enrich your gaming experience!

[h3]NEW MAP:[/h3]
An exciting new map is now available for special operations, bringing the total number of maps to 20, with more to come this year! The "ARIAL Offshore Drilling" oil platform is located in the heart of the ocean and has recently been attacked by an enemy group.

This first vertical map of the game will require caution and strategy to gain the upper hand on your opponents. It consists of several levels, with numerous stairs and walkways providing access to objectives.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/4cac281157029437165f0508074e188cef4594dd.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/c29ea90448f15f8f0c50585f27fb5af7fd12a5be.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/ac91178359823951d17102d31389e17b89dc9d89.jpg[/img]

[h3]NEW TASK:[/h3]
A new task, called "Encrypted Data", is now available in the mission menu. To succeed, you will need to recover an encryption key hidden on the map and then use this key to extract sensitive data. This two-step objective is perfect for discreet infiltration missions.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/ec962f2ef76f78b988b794938688366ccf3d4f27.jpg[/img]

[h3]GAMEPLAY:[/h3]
To optimize gameplay, several improvements have been made to make combat more dynamic. The revival and operator marking systems have been completely redesigned, becoming simpler and more efficient, allowing players to react quickly if they are attacked while rescuing a teammate.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/ea96601fa8ebd934a01dfc1b73d9b2f0c1fc3ec7.jpg[/img]

As always, this update also includes numerous diverse improvements and fixes.

A big thank you to the entire community for your support and invaluable help in the ongoing improvement of the game.

Best regards,
Helios

notes.title: Update 1.42: Camouflage overhaul, rangefinder
notes.content:
Dear Operators,

Update 1.42 is available and it will radically change the customization of your soldiers.

[h3]Camouflage overhaul:[/h3]

A huge amount of work has been done to offer a complete overhaul of the choice of
camouflage for clothing and equipment during operator creation. The result will offer
improved graphics and greater customization options. You can customize your squad
according to your play style, preferences, and combat environment.

In addition, significant improvements have been made to the rendering of camouflage
to make them more realistic and detailed. This will allow you to fully immerse yourself
in the game environment and face your enemies.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/a7176158c3ae7a5663cd46feda0c5172f3297bb6.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/e4119ef6b5cb801871db4982786228b2d553af77.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/733728d29a3d70406cf0cbd6786c531d9899de12.jpg[/img]

[h3]Raptor-S rangefinder:[/h3]

The Raptor-S rangefinder is a distance-measuring device that will allow you to
evaluate the distance between you and your target in real time. You can accurately
estimate the distance of your targets and adjust your weapon settings for unparalleled
accuracy. The Raptor-S rangefinder will be integrated into the scope interface.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/579d6cc7c0d7dde03452cf77659be36e8f217e83.jpg[/img]

Best regards,
Helios

notes.title: Preview 1.42: Camouflage overhaul, rangefinder
notes.content:
Dear Operators,

Update 1.42 is scheduled for release in the coming weeks, and it will radically change
the customization of your soldiers.

[h3]Camouflage overhaul:[/h3]

A huge amount of work has been done to offer a complete overhaul of the choice of
camouflage for clothing and equipment during operator creation. The result will offer
improved graphics and greater customization options. You can customize your squad
according to your play style, preferences, and combat environment.

In addition, significant improvements have been made to the rendering of camouflage
to make them more realistic and detailed. This will allow you to fully immerse yourself
in the game environment and face your enemies.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/a7176158c3ae7a5663cd46feda0c5172f3297bb6.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/e4119ef6b5cb801871db4982786228b2d553af77.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/1d558f32b545693f11f029d82424f910b84bb941.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/8d02d1180a833b9df8dfda4713c6f42df8a7e93a.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/733728d29a3d70406cf0cbd6786c531d9899de12.jpg[/img]

[h3]Raptor-S rangefinder:[/h3]

The Raptor-S rangefinder is a distance-measuring device that will allow you to
evaluate the distance between you and your target in real time. You can accurately
estimate the distance of your targets and adjust your weapon settings for unparalleled
accuracy. The Raptor-S rangefinder will be integrated into the scope interface.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/579d6cc7c0d7dde03452cf77659be36e8f217e83.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/c8c1e7e4795c807fdd974589e7d7a21b959adf85.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40417083/1314679bad93423c7b459257a8e6ad370859e0b3.jpg[/img]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]

Of course, this update will bring its fair share of improvements and fixes to enhance the gameplay experience. Get ready!

Best regards,
Helios

notes.title: Update 1.41: AI, optional tasks, new awards
notes.content:
Dear operators,

Update 1.41 is now online. It adds many improvements as well as new content.

The enemy AI has been improved to make it more believable and dangerous. Now, the enemy will attempt to throw a grenade at a covered operator to eliminate them. In addition, the AI will better use the cover of the environment to protect itself. Finally, a significant optimization of the AI has been made to improve the fluidity of the game and correct many slowdowns.

To finish, optional objectives are finally available and can be chosen in the mission configuration. 6 new rewards are to be won at the end of the mission and many gameplay improvements have been made.

Cheers,
Helios
